label: DOM_SELECTOR_DRIFT
notes: Fault injection: a new full-page consent layer intercepts pointer events, so the click times out. The app works for a user who dismisses it; the test needs to handle the new UI element. Hard: "element intercepts pointer events" can also be a real layout bug, and the decision rule (new intended UI = drift) needs product context.
